instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the selected fonts: Cabinet Grotesk for Headings and Satoshi for Body. Do not use Inter or generic defaults.
Use pure sharp corners (rounded-none) for cards, buttons, and inputs to emulate high-end fashion editorial layouts.
Ensure the layout mimics a high-performance F-pattern enterprise dashboard but styled with 'Jewel & Luxury' spacing constraints. Pad cards generously (p-6 to p-8).
Replace standard rainbow heatmaps or bright charts with monochromatic or dual-tone charts using the primary accent #C4A47C and neutral grays.
Do NOT use HTML inputs. Use Shadcn components for Select, Tabs, Tables, etc. Customize Shadcn rounded corners to be completely square.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, navigation links, form inputs, and key UI interactive elements.
For the file dropzone, utilize a dashed border with a subtle hover transition to a solid #0A0A0A border.
For charts, use Recharts with strict monochromatic or brand accent colors. Avoid default colors.
